title: coleus ternatus
intro: Coleus ternatus, commonly known as Coleus, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, known for its vibrant foliage and medicinal properties. The leaves of the Coleus plant have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, headache, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve cognitive function, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The bioactive constituents of Coleus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
